children: According to CNBC, American Airlines’ last long-haul international flight with an eight-suite first-class cabin landed this week, ending the last international first-class service among U.S. airlines. Delta Air Lines and United Airlines had already phased out the cabins. American’s redesigned Boeing 777-300ERs will have 70 business-class suites, up from 52 business-class suites and eight first-class suites before the overhaul. The remodeling is ongoing, and American is evaluating whether to increase business-class suites on its Boeing 787-8 aircraft from 20 to somewhere in the 30s.

title: U.S. Airlines End International First Class; American Plans 70 Business Suites
